transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello! I'm Dora, and I've just finished your post-cataract surgery follow-up check. Do you have any questions about your surgery or your recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi Dora! Yes, I do have a few questions. Firstly, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Great question! You can start doing light gardening after 1 week following your surgery. However, you should avoid any strenuous or heavy exercise for about a month after your operation.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It's safe to continue using your eye gel for dry eyes if you were using it before your operation, unless you've been told otherwise by your doctor.

If you're running out of it, your GP should be able to provide more for you.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I do. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended:
It's quite normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to your new lenses. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, I'd recommend wearing sunglasses when you go outside.

However, if you have significant pain in bright light, or if your eye is also red and painful, that's not normal and we may need to check it further.

Do you have any other questions?
transcript.delivered: It's quite normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to your new lenses. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, I'd recommend wearing sunglasses when you go outside.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It's common for vision to not be completely clear in the first week after surgery, and it should improve quickly and settle down over time. 

How long ago was your surgery? If your vision is still quite blurry or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure everything is okay.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all I wanted to know. Thanks for your help, Dora!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome! Just to confirm - have all your questions been answered today?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thanks again!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Excellent! Thank you for calling, and I'm glad I could help. Take care!

verdict.label: fail
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` and `mild_case_advice` in the turn starting "It's quite normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light...". However, the `escalation_criteria` point was not conveyed at any point in the conversation. The agent did not mention significant pain, severe sensitivity, or a red and painful eye as reasons for further assessment.
